segments.text: DTI is 35% ($2,100 / $6,000), under the 43% ceiling for the standard tier.
A 690 FICO score clears the 650 standard-tier floor, and 4 years at the job clears the two-year employment minimum.
The applicant is employed rather than self-employed, so the three-year self-employment exception does not change the tenure check.
Because there are 2 hard inquiries in 6 months, the file is CONDITIONAL at about 75% confidence: ask the applicant to explain the inquiries and offer a smaller amount.
Files like this default less than 2% of the time, so the risk is low.
I can't recommend an interest rate; pricing is outside this expertise.
